note: 意識とはの文献レビュー（#95）で、原典から照合し直した領域の記録。as のトップに一覧で出し、押すと記録を開く。済んだ領域を一行ずつ足す。一覧の先頭には、lead に書いた論点と回答の文書（answers.md）を置く（書きかけで、工事中の所もそのまま見せる。2026-11-12・docs/as-review/loop2.md の判断 3）。足したら、as/llms.txt の記録の一覧と、as/index.html の noscript の一覧にも一行足す。name と summary は画面に出す文で、領域の記号を入れない。点検は scripts/check-as-evidence.mjs。

lead.name_ja: 論点と回答：既存の知見はどう言っているか
lead.name_en: Questions and answers: what existing research says
lead.summary_ja: このページの問いごとに、下の記録の研究がどう言っているかを並べた文書。答えの書けていない所は、工事中のまま置いています
lead.summary_en: For each question on this page, how the research in the records below speaks to it. Parts not yet answered are left marked as under construction

areas.summary_ja: 体験の記述をどう取り、神経の測定とどう突き合わせるか。その記述はどこまで信頼できるか
areas.summary_en: How descriptions of experience are gathered and set against neural measures, and how far those descriptions can be trusted

areas.summary_ja: 脳のモデルの予測と予測誤差は、意識に上ることとどう関わるか。予測処理は意識の理論か
areas.summary_en: How prediction and prediction error relate to what reaches awareness, and whether predictive processing is a theory of consciousness

areas.summary_ja: メタ認知や瞑想で、自分を観ること、自己の境界が薄れることは、どう記述され、何が測られてきたか
areas.summary_en: How watching one's own mind and the thinning of the sense of self have been described and measured in metacognition and meditation research

areas.summary_ja: 体の内側の信号は、どう感じとして意識に上るか。情動は生まれつきの回路か、その場で組み立てられるか
areas.summary_en: How signals from inside the body come to be felt, and whether emotions are built-in circuits or constructed in the moment

areas.summary_ja: 不確かさ・不安・ストレスと、安全の知覚。生き延びる危うさへの反応が既定で、安全の知覚がそれを抑えるという見方と、その批判
areas.summary_en: Uncertainty, anxiety and stress, and the perception of safety: the view that a stress response is the default and perceived safety inhibits it, and its critics

areas.summary_ja: 愛着と安全の基地、乳児期のやり取り、関係による調整、所属と孤独。関係は、脅威や体の負担の見積もりをどう変えるか
areas.summary_en: Attachment and the secure base, early infant interaction, social regulation, belonging and loneliness: how relationships change the appraisal of threat and bodily cost

areas.name_ja: 間主観性の哲学と臨床
areas.name_en: Intersubjectivity in philosophy and the clinic
areas.summary_ja: 他者の経験は推論の前にじかに与えられるか。身体どうしのやり取り、乳児期の間主観性、臨床の抱える環境と、その批判
areas.summary_en: Whether others' experience is given directly before inference: embodied interaction, infant intersubjectivity, the clinical holding environment, and their critics

areas.name_ja: 意識とメタ意識の区別
areas.summary_ja: 意識される経験と、それに気づくこと（メタ意識・内観）は、どう分けられてきたか。意識の高次の理論、現象の意識と接近の意識の区別と、その批判
areas.summary_en: How conscious experience has been told apart from becoming aware of it (meta-awareness, introspection): higher-order theories, the phenomenal/access distinction, and their critics

areas.summary_ja: 身を守る反応と、快・不快や信頼・嫌悪は、研究でどう分けられてきたか。体への脅威と、人との間での自分への脅威は別の系か。数は二つか
areas.summary_en: How research has divided defensive reactions from pleasure and displeasure, trust and disgust; whether threats to the body and threats to one's social standing run on separate systems; and whether two kinds are enough

areas.summary_ja: 人と人のあいだで、何が信号として測られてきたか。二人の脳や体の同期は、やり取りの経験をなすのか、同じ入力の副産物か。近年の論と、その批判
areas.summary_en: What has been measured as a signal between people; whether synchrony between two brains and bodies makes up the experience of interacting or is a by-product of shared input; recent accounts and their critics

areas.name_ja: 安定とつながりの感じ・手放す構え
areas.summary_ja: 大人の安定感・平静・つながりの感じ・畏れは、どう記述され、何で測られてきたか。手放す構えと急いで閉じる構えの尺度。自己の境界がゆるむ体験が苦しさとして報告される場合と、尺度への批判
areas.summary_en: How a settled sense of stability, equanimity, connectedness and awe in adults has been described and measured; scales for letting go and for the need to reach closure; cases where loosening the boundaries of the self is reported as distress; and critiques of the scales

areas.name_ja: 信頼の定義と長い時間の動機
areas.summary_ja: 信頼は、分野ごとにどう定義され、何で測られてきたか。長い時間の目標で、つながりの欠けが地位やお金の目標で埋められると書く研究と、その向き。つながりと身を守る動機の衝突を比べた研究
areas.summary_en: How trust has been defined and measured across fields; research on long-term goals in which a lack of connection is filled by goals of status and money, and which way the link runs; and studies that compare the conflict between connection and self-protection motives

areas.name_ja: 一列の記号と、そこに乗らない値
areas.name_en: Symbols and the values they do not carry
areas.summary_ja: 言葉や数値の報告は、体の反応や行動とどこまでそろうか。声の調子や顔を合わせることが、信頼や協力にどう効くか。関係の値をお金に乗せることへの反発。言葉にならない感じの出どころの仮説と、その批判
areas.summary_en: How far verbal and numerical reports line up with bodily responses and behaviour; how tone of voice and face-to-face contact bear on trust and cooperation; resistance to putting relationship values into money; and hypotheses about where unspoken feelings come from, with their critiques

areas.summary_ja: 注意は、脅威の手がかりと人の手がかりを、どう選んで拾うか。価値や関心が注意を引く研究と、測り方の信頼性への批判。顕著性のネットワークは何を拾うと書かれてきたか
areas.summary_en: How attention picks out threat cues and social cues; studies in which value and concern capture attention, and critiques of how reliably these are measured; and what the salience network has been said to pick up

areas.summary_ja: 本人が答える動機と、物語で測る動機は、どこまでそろうか。自分を知ることの限界と、人生の語りの中での気づき。感じの原因の取り違えの実験と、その追試
areas.summary_en: How far self-reported motives match motives measured through stories; the limits of self-knowledge and noticing within life narratives; and experiments on misattributing the cause of a feeling, with their replications

areas.name_ja: 神経系の分かれ方と二つの信号
areas.name_en: Divisions of the nervous system and the two signals
areas.summary_ja: 身を守る信号とつながりの信号を、神経系のどこかで分けた研究はあるか。脳を古い層と新しい層に分ける見方とその批判、小脳と情動、脊髄と心臓の神経系、つながりとストレスの物質の系
areas.summary_en: Whether any research divides self-protective signals from signals of connection somewhere in the nervous system: the view of the brain as old and new layers and its critics, the cerebellum and emotion, the spinal cord and the heart's nervous system, and the chemical systems of bonding and stress
